name: audit-registry-snapshot-ast-removal
title: Remove skill_review AST registry fallback once both packs ship snapshots
description: UNBLOCKED 2026-08-16: the SD twin producer shipped in platypeeps/sd-ai-command-pack#483, squash-merged as 232138a8, and generated/registry-snapshot.json is present on that pack's main. Both SE and SD now ship the generated registry snapshot, so a bounded PR removes _parse_registry and its AST helpers (_assignment, _string_value, _call_value) plus the fallback branch and symlink-fallback path in skill_review.py, and makes _load_registry_snapshot the sole registry source. This meets the strict acceptance criterion 'skill_review.py no longer opens installer/registry.py' fleet-wide. Update the code-spec quality-guidelines.md snapshot-preferred section and drop the AST-fallback tests.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Was blocked on 08-04-audit-registry-snapshot-sd-twin; unblocked 2026-08-16 when that task's upstream PR merged (232138a8). Removal surface: _parse_registry (:340), _assignment (:224), _string_value (:235), _call_value (:241), fallback branch (:427-428), and the None return at :317-318.
